# Frontline Wildfire

> > Frontline Wildfire provides integrated wildfire protection systems combining exterior sprinkler technology with real-time fire tracking and emergency alerts.

Frontline Wildfire offers both active protection solutions through automated sprinkler systems for homes and businesses, and passive awareness through its comprehensive wildfire tracking app and interactive fire maps covering major western states. The platform serves residential homeowners, new home communities, and specialized facilities like summer camps and wineries.

## Key Topics

- Frontline Wildfire Defense System
- Exterior sprinkler system
- Real-time fire tracking
- Interactive fire maps
- Wildfire alerts
- Home protection
- Emergency preparedness
- Fire perimeters
- Thermal hotspots
- Mobile app (iOS/Android)
- Evacuation information
- Wildfire safety
- Defense System 2
- Fire-resistant environments
- Community protection

## Core Protection Systems

- [Frontline Wildfire Defense System: Protect Your Home from Wildfires](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com): Frontline's complete wildfire protection system for homes and businesses.
- [Wildfire Sprinkler System for Ultimate Home Protection](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/protect-home-with-roof-wildfire-sprinkler-system): Exterior wildfire sprinkler system creating fire-resistant environments.
- [Wildfire Protection for New Home Construction](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/wildfire-protection-for-new-home-construction): Integrated wildfire defense for new residential construction projects.
- [Wildfire Protection for New Home Communities](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/wildfire-protection-for-new-home-communities): Wildfire defense systems for homebuilders and community developments.

## Specialized Industry Solutions

- [Wildfire Protection for Summer Camps](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/wildfire-protection-for-summer-camps): Sprinkler system designed to protect summer camps from wildfires.
- [Wildfire Protection for Wineries](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/wildfire-protection-for-wineries): Exterior sprinkler solution protecting wineries with foam technology.

## Real-Time Fire Tracking & Alerts

- [Wildfire App | Frontline](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/frontline-wildfire-app): Free wildfire tracking app with comprehensive emergency alerts.
- [Live Fire Map: Track Wildfires Near You](https://www.frontlinewildfire.com/live-fire-map-track-wildfires-near-you): Interactive live fire map with customized wildfire alerts and tracking.
